videos.title: GTA 6 Ultimate vs Standard: what the extra $20 buys
lines: Do not pay a hundred dollars for GTA 6 until you hear this.
Standard is eighty bucks. Ultimate is a hundred.
That extra twenty buys sixteen items. A ninety-five Grotti Cheetah. Two revolvers. A speedboat. A buggy with its own garage.
The list also names two mod shops, a tattoo parlor, a salon and a clothing store.
None of it is story. It's cars, guns, and places to spend money.
But reviewers keep saying money is hard to come by in this game. So free cars early on are worth more than they sound.
Here's the part the store page buries. Standard owners can buy the exact same upgrade later.
So buy Standard. Play ten hours. Upgrade only if you're broke in Vice City.

inserts.label: Money is hard to come by

videos.title: GTA 6 on Xbox Series S: the real numbers
lines: GTA 6 runs at thirty frames per second. On every console.
Yes, even the PS5 Pro. Push Square's review says there is no option to double it.
PS5, PS5 Pro and Series X reportedly render at fourteen forty p, upscaled to four K.
The Series S? Seven twenty p, upscaled to ten eighty.
And early testing reported by BGR puts it in the twenties while driving, and around twenty when several cars explode at once.
So is the Series S unplayable? No. Walking around and cutscenes hold thirty.
But if you're choosing a console for this game, that gap is what you're paying for.

videos.title: How to make money in GTA 6 (what reviewers actually did)
lines: You are going to be broke in GTA 6. Reviewers all say the same thing. Money is hard to come by.
So here is where the cash actually is.
One. Gas station stick-ups. Small money, low effort.
Two. Gang hideouts. The game calls them illegal operations. Clear one out and you leave with cash, drugs and high-value items.
Three. Don't sit on the drugs. Sell them to a fence.
Four. Jewelry stores. Scout first. Cut the alarm before you smash a display, and the cops never get called.
Five. Erase the security tapes, and the police don't get your description.
The big bank heists unlock later. Until then, hideouts are your paycheck.
videos.pill: How to get rich in GTA 6

inserts.label: Sell the drugs to a fence

videos.title: GTA 6 cops don't work like GTA 5 cops
videos.hook: THE COPS HAVE TO FIND YOU
lines: In GTA 5, the cops always knew where you were. In GTA 6, they have to find you.
Police now work from witness reports and evidence. A body. A car you abandoned.
They call in a sighting before they even know who you are.
So what gets you caught? Your outfit and your car. Cops recognise both.
That's why you can keep five outfits in your trunk. Change clothes and your heat drops.
They also have K9 units that can sense you.
And if you rob a place with Lucia, they're looking for a duo. So split up.
One more thing. Enemies are gone from your radar. You have to actually look.

videos.title: GTA 6 tracks your relationship with Lucia
videos.hook: YOU CAN RUIN IT WITH LUCIA
lines: GTA 6 tracks your relationship with Lucia. And you can neglect it.
Early on, the game gives you an optional job. Decorate Jason's beach house before she arrives.
Do it, and the bond gets stronger. Skip it and, according to Push Square's review, she notices.
You can hold hands. Go on dates. Go clubbing.
A kiss on the penthouse balcony raises the bond too.
Or ignore all of it. The developers told The Gamer the relationship is something you earn, or leave alone.
Here's why that matters. The game has multiple endings, and they depend on your choices.
So the couple you build is part of how this story ends.

videos.title: 6 things from GTA 5 you can't do in GTA 6
lines: Six things you did in GTA 5 that GTA 6 won't let you do.
One. Carry every gun you own. Your loadout is limited now. The rest lives in your trunk.
Two. Steal any car in two seconds. Old cars, you jimmy the lock. Sports cars and EVs need a key cloner.
Three. Mash X to sprint. That's gone.
Four. See enemies on your radar. Removed.
Five. Ignore your body. You eat, you sleep, you fuel the car. Hit the gym and you build muscle.
Six. Get rich fast. Reviewers say money is hard to earn.
Bonus. The boxed copy reportedly has no disc. It's a download code in a case.

inserts.label: boxed copy is reportedly a download code

videos.title: How big is the GTA 6 map, really?
lines: How big is the GTA 6 map? Rockstar's answer is about twice the size of GTA 5.
Six regions. Vice City. The Leonida Keys. Grassrivers. Port Gellhorn. Ambrosia. And Mount Kalaga National Park.
But the size isn't the scary part.
Vice's reviewer played for over a hundred and thirty hours. Finished the story. Did most of the side content.
And still hadn't set foot in sixty percent of the world.
The story alone runs sixty to eighty hours, depending on which reviewer you ask.
A full hundred percent? Push Square says up to three hundred.
